verdict.rationale: Clerky documents a REST Partner API (document sets, forms, lifecycle polling) with OAuth that is still marked 'coming soon', plus a remote MCP server. Nothing in the evidence mentions an official SDK or client library in any language, so integrators would have to call the raw REST endpoints. Official SDKs are a fair axis for a SaaS with a public API, so the absence of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.
